# Transcribed by session arena-473e08d5-x1. The fetch tool returns no per-call clock, so the read is
# stamped with the sandbox wall clock taken immediately after the pair of calls, not with a time the
# source itself printed.
# One row per fixture AS PRINTED by the official page. status="Final" = the page prints a final score and
# a "Final" label. Week 10 is COMPLETE at this read: 14 fixtures, 14 finals, 0 scheduled.
# away_record / home_record are the club records printed beside each club logo on THIS page (post-game).
#   They are cross-checked against the separate official standings page read in the same window by
#   tools/verify_2026_11_17.py, so a record must agree across two official pages to be published.
# time_et / network blank = this read of the page did not print a kickoff time or a network string per
#   game (the 2026-11-16 read of the same page did; the two renders differ). Blank is NOT "unknown and
#   filled in from the older read": the older read is published separately at
#   data/verification/2026_11_16/official_w10_results_2026_11_16.tsv and the 13 overlapping finals are
#   diffed against it by the verifier instead of copied.
# venue blank = the weekly schedule page prints no venue field; venues come from each Game Center page
